items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I think it was Cloris Leachman, and she thought she could sing or something.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he’d worked in the pit behind her on Broadway. He says, “Don’t worry.” He says, “when Ethel starts you go, and when she stops it’s over.”
Isn’t that nice to be in that position? Oh. I have one personal memory of the Tonight Show that I had to ask about. I think it was Cloris Leachman, and she thought she could sing or something.
